We got list of templates. Need one that matches our target molecule. We should check each template's applicability using check_smiles_reaction_template_matching. Choose one that returns True. Likely the first template (reaction_id 401931) seems to involve amide formation with conjugated system? Our target has an amide attached to aromatic ring and a sulfonamide etc. The template's retro_smarts: '[#7:2]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])/[CH;D2;+0:4]=[C:5]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-O-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](-[#7:2])=[O;D1;H0:3].O-C(=O)-[CH;D2;+0:4]=[C:5]'

That seems to be amide formation from activated ester (tert-butyl carbonate?). Might match. Let's test first template id = 401931. Use check.
